title: Cursed Fate: Potions & Scrolls Addon Vanilla/Cursed Fate Style
description: This Resource Pack Changes the textures of the Cursed Potion & Scrolls (Cursed fate addon) to be more vanilla/cursed fate like and less over detailed
body:
This Resource Pack changes the textures of the Cursed Potion & Scrolls (Cursed fate addon) to a more vanilla/cursed fate style instead of it being overdetailed

!!! This resource pack will do nothing without the Cursed Potion & Scrolls (Cursed fate addon) !!!
